letyoudespawn.config.desc: Tweak mob despawn rules so mobs do not become permanent just because they picked something up.
letyoudespawn.config.despawning.desc: Controls which mobs may despawn, and what happens to the gear they picked up.
letyoudespawn.config.despawning.mobNames: These mobs still become persistent after picking an item up, exactly like vanilla (entity ids, e.g. corpse:corpse).
letyoudespawn.config.despawning.persiste: A mob that picked one of these up and is wearing it is kept alive when it would otherwise despawn (item ids).
letyoudespawn.config.despawning.pickOpen: Open a searchable list; click a row to add it to, or remove it from, the lists above.
letyoudespawn.config.despawning.enableSt: Mobs spawned by a monster spawner can still despawn after picking something up, instead of being pinned as persistent.
letyoudespawn.config.despawning.enableTr: Same as above, for trial spawners; a mob still counted by its trial spawner never despawns, which is what stops idle reward farming.
